<title level="1" right="Class Feature 19">[Guardian Mastery](/Classes.aspx?ID=67)</title>

<column gap="tiny">
**Source** [Battlecry!](/Sources.aspx?ID=268) pg. 37

**Class** Guardian
</column>

---

You are known for your suit of armor more than the person inside. Your proficiency rank for your guardian class DC increases to master. While wearing armor, when you attempt a Reflex save to avoid a damaging effect, such as a [_fireball_](/Spells.aspx?ID=1530), you can add your armor’s item bonus to AC instead of your Dexterity modifier; if your armor has the bulwark trait, increase this bonus by 1. If you get a success when you do this, you get a critical success instead.
name: Guardian Mastery
